outcome: KeepAlive does not cache a suspense child that never mounted, so a later activation does not resurrect an empty subtree

acceptance_criteria.text: A suspense subtree that is deactivated before it resolves is not written into the KeepAlive cache.

expected_verification.assertion: deactivating a KeepAlive-wrapped Suspense before its async child resolves leaves no entry for it in the cache

acceptance_criteria.text: Re-activating a KeepAlive-wrapped Suspense that did resolve still renders its resolved content rather than an empty subtree.

expected_verification.assertion: switching back to a resolved async child inside KeepAlive renders its content

data_impact: None. KeepAlive's cache is in-memory component state for the lifetime of a page.
security_impact: None. The guard narrows what is cached; it grants no new access and reads no new input.
rollout: Ships with the package. No flag: the change is a narrowing of an existing cache write.
rollback: git revert. Before the change an unresolved suspense child was written to the cache, so a revert restores that.
